market_question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Ethereum historically experiences 50-70% drawdowns within a year after cycle peaks. With the current bull run likely peaking in 2025 and macro uncertainty ahead, a drop to $1500 by end of 2026 appears more likely than the market's 44% implies. However, crypto timing is highly unpredictable, limiting confidence.
evidence_points: ETH suffered >80% drawdowns in 2018 and 2022 bear markets within a year
Current price near all-time highs, suggesting room for a sharp correction
Macro headwinds (rate sensitivity, recession fears) could trigger a crypto sell-off
sources_consulted: Historical ETH/USDT price data on Binance
General knowledge of crypto market cycles
